text:
Politics at Sam and Anne’s Two of Westminster’s best-connected journalists Anne McElvoy and Sam Coates bring you everything you need to know about British politics.
Apple Music Amazon Music Sky News Is the battle over welfare reforms about to intensify?
With the Milburn Report on youth unemployment just a week away, Sam Coates and Anne McElvoy examine the growing pressure on Labour to tackle the issue.
And with the head of the civil service, Antonia Romeo, preparing Whitehall for a spending squeeze, the Conservatives are planning to set out how they would trim £36bn from the benefits bill. Where will the money come from and who will bear the costs?
Elsewhere, Sam hears some rumblings that Number 10 North is already being branded a “government think tank”.
Plus, does the weekly polling show signs of a Tory fightback and are Reform beginning to suffer?
